atoms.text: Arthur now wants to take you to see England’s landscapes. Will you go around the countryside with him?

instruction.text: Arthur wants to know if you recognise what English landscapes look like. Select the three images of landscapes in England.

feedback.end: England is covered with lots of greenery. You'll find hills, valleys, forests and fields all around the country.
feedback.wrong: This is a desert in Africa. England’s climate is a lot more humid and mild, so you won’t find any deserts here!

instruction.text: Arthur asks if you know the names of landscapes you might see around England. Drag the images to the correct words.
Arthur has marked three famous natural areas in England on his map. Find the Lake District on the map to visit it.
This is the Lake District. Find the lake in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: The Lake District is a famous national park. It is home to the largest lake in England, Lake Windermere, as well as the tallest mountain in England, Scafell Pike.

instruction.text: Find the White Cliffs of Dover on the map to visit it.
These are the White Cliffs of Dover. Find the cliffs in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: These cliffs are white because they are made of chalk. You can look out across the English Channel from here - France is just across the sea!

instruction.text: Find Cheddar Gorge on the map to visit it.
This is Cheddar Gorge. Find the road in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: Cheddar Gorge is England’s largest gorge, which is a deep valley between steep cliffs. It has lots of caves to explore. In fact, Britain’s oldest complete human skeleton was found in these caves!
